title: Core editing and deterministic object-selection workflows
objective: Restore the next bounded CAD editing layer: deterministic object-selection and core modify workflows over the verified shared geometry, precision and viewport foundations, without changing ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1 or canonical authority.
acceptance_criteria: Representative G1/G2/G4/G10 selection/edit workflows complete through the real UI with deterministic evidence.
Selection, picking and Properties/status surfaces agree on one canonical live selection.
Supported edits produce exact deterministic canonical geometry and one revision per mutating command under the existing command model.
Undo/redo restores exact prior state without phantom or stale selection.
Invalid and unsupported edit cases fail explicitly and never fabricate geometry or success.
Web/Electron execute the same semantic command paths and converge on equivalent affected serialized state.
COMPAT-CAD-005 and COMPAT-CAD-006 verified behavior remains regression-green, including layer identity, canonical selection, picking, navigation, and no-mutation guarantees.
No frozen Architecture v1.1 boundary, Construction Graph authority, or engine/adapter boundary is modified without an ACR.
non_goals: No ARRAY materialization/render/selectability; COMPAT-CAD-008 owns DEF-015.
No durable SAVE/OPEN or serverless multi-instance session persistence; COMPAT-CAD-011 / infrastructure track.
No unrelated BIM, documentation or interoperability expansion.
No architecture modification without an ACR.
No full AutoCAD parity claim and no benchmark score change without a benchmark rerun.
risk_assumptions: COMPAT-CAD-006 is the required verified viewport/transform baseline and its shared transform module remains the canonical screen/world conversion path.
The existing engine-free shared geometry/precision core is sufficient for the bounded selection/edit slice; unsupported cases remain typed rather than approximated.
Interactive previews and transient selection remain presentation state until canonical commit.
The known main-side CAD-PARITY-020 governance defect may keep root governance red; it is Architect-owned and must not be modified by this work item.
ARRAY, durable persistence, DXF and layout identity remain independent successor concerns even where this phase makes their prerequisite selection/edit flows usable.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated selection/edit tests including invalid and unsupported cases.
Negative tests proving previews/transient selection do not mutate canonical state before commit and failures do not emit false success.
Web/Electron parity evidence over the affected semantic stream.
Regression evidence for COMPAT-CAD-005 and COMPAT-CAD-006.
Exact-head CI evidence with pre-existing main-side failures isolated honestly.
Exact-head deployment and independent browser-agent evidence.
Real browser Golden G1, G2, G4 and G10 execution plus targeted DEF-006/007/021 probes.
Revision-bound evidence recorded in this governance record before Architect review.
